description: Unit test class for the ModuleUtil class within the OpenMRS project; contains test methods verifying various functionalities of module management utilities.

classes.name: ModuleUtilIT
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying the behaviors of ModuleUtil methods such as URL handling, module version checks, path resolutions, and repository access within the OpenMRS module system.

methods.name: getURLStream_shouldReturnAValidInputStreamForOldModuleUrls
methods.description: Tests that ModuleUtil correctly retrieves a URL stream for a given module URL, requiring internet connectivity.

methods.name: getURL_shouldReturnAnUpdateRdfPageForOldHttpsDevUrls
methods.description: Disabled test to verify that ModuleUtil can fetch an RDF update page from a specified HTTPS URL.

methods.name: getURL_shouldReturnAnUpdateRdfPageForOldHttpsModuleUrls
methods.description: Disabled test similar to above, for a different URL.

methods.name: getURL_shouldReturnAnUpdateRdfPageForModuleUrls
methods.description: Disabled test to verify fetching RDF from an HTTP URL.

methods.name: checkMandatoryModulesStarted_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfAMandatoryModuleIsNotStarted
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown when mandatory modules are not started.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules_shouldReturnMandatoryModuleIds
methods.description: Checks that the list of mandatory module IDs is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedRequiredVersion
methods.description: Tests version range matching allowing specific range.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedRequiredVersionWithWildCard
methods.description: Tests version range matching with wildcard characters.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedRequiredVersionWithWildCardOnOneEnd
methods.description: Verifies matching with wildcards on one end of version range.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowSingleEntryForRequiredVersion
methods.description: Tests matching when only a single version is specified.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRequiredVersionWithWildCard
methods.description: Verifies wildcard matching for exact versions.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowNonNumericCharacterRequiredVersion
methods.description: Tests matching with non-numeric characters in version string.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedNonNumericCharacterRequiredVersion
methods.description: Tests ranged matching with non-numeric characters.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedNonNumericCharacterWithWildCard
methods.description: Tests ranged matching with wildcards and non-numeric characters.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedNonNumericCharacterWithWildCardOnOneEnd
methods.description: Verifies ranged matching with wildcards on one end and non-numeric characters.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenOpenmrsVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Ensures mismatches are correctly identified when openmrs version exceeds range.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenRequiredVersionBeyondOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Checks that versions outside the specified range return false.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenRequiredVersionWithWildCardBeyondOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Tests that wildcards beyond actual version return false.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenRequiredVersionWithWildCardOnOneEndBeyondOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Verifies wildcards on one end are correctly applied with version mismatch.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldReturnFalseWhenSingleEntryRequiredVersionBeyondOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Checks that exact version mismatches return false.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowReleaseTypeInTheVersion
methods.description: Tests that versions with release type suffixes are matched appropriately.

methods.name: getPathForResource_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssExample
methods.description: Verifies proper path transformation for resources within a module.

methods.description: Checks module detection for a resource path when the module is active.

methods.description: Verifies module detection for resource path with 'ui' module active.

methods.name: getModuleForPath_shouldReturnNullForUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssWhenNoRelevantModuleIsRunning
methods.description: Ensures null is returned if no matching module is active for resource path.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfOpenmrsVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown if the openmrs version exceeds the allowed range.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfRequiredVersionBeyondOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Checks exception thrown when required version is higher than current.

methods.description: Verifies exception with wildcards in version mismatch.

methods.description: Test for wildcards on one side causing mismatch.

methods.description: Checks exception with exact version outside current version.
